getyourguide-from-accra-the-cape-coast-d.text: This has been our 3rd tour with Expedition-go Tours and every single on of our tours has been amazing. We have been very pleased with all the tour guides we have had and for this tour we had Wisdom. Wisdom was both our driver and guide and he was excellent in both rolls! The roads were truly a challenge but Wisdom did a phenominal job in getting us to our location and home safely. Cape Cost Castle was the highligt of our tour. What an informative and moving tour. As a Ghanaian myself I am truly proud of all the guides and Mr. Nana Akoh Appiah at the Cape Cost Castle was an outstanding tour guide! I have never come across better. I highly recommend this tour!

tripadvisor-25217516.title: Exceeded My Expectations 10/10
tripadvisor-25217516.text:
Thank you so much for everything you did to make this journey so special. I have been looking forward to responding because I truly wanted to express how grateful we are.

Our experience with Expedition Go Tours exceeded every expectation. The level of professionalism, organization, and exceptional service your team provided from beginning to end made us feel welcomed, cared for, and safe throughout our journey.

What made this trip extraordinary, however, were the people. Our guides quickly became more than guides—they became family. They didn't simply take us from one destination to another; they walked alongside us, shared their hearts, answered every question with patience, and gave us a genuine understanding of Ghana's history, culture, traditions, and people. Their passion was contagious, and because of them, we experienced Ghana in a way that no guidebook could ever provide.

As a group, my clients and I left Ghana forever changed. We laughed together, reflected together, and experienced emotions that are difficult to put into words. Standing in places like Cape Coast, being welcomed by families during our naming ceremony, sharing meals, and interacting with so many beautiful people created memories that will stay with us for a lifetime. We didn't feel like tourists—we felt connected to the culture, the history, and the people.

Please extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who played a part in making this journey so meaningful, especially our guides. Their kindness, professionalism, and genuine care made all the difference, and they represented Expedition Go Tours with excellence.

Thank you again for helping create an experience that touched our hearts and strengthened our connection to Ghana. I look forward to bringing many more groups to experience the same warmth, excellence, and hospitality that Expedition Go Tours provided.

With sincere appreciation,

Julia

tripadvisor-25275033.title: Wonderful day trip, personalized experience!
tripadvisor-25275033.text: My spouse and I had a truly great time on this wonderful day trip from Accra! We very much enjoyed the serene landscapes of Shai national Parc and Volta River. Emanuel was a perfect guide and went to great lengths to cater to our interests and personalize the experience. At our request, we went for a walk in the Shai hills and we stopped at Akosombo bridge for a short stroll across and foto opportunity. Everything else was also arranged perfectly. We had lunch in a very nice restaurant with a beautiful terrace overlooking the river and went on a peaceful and relaxing boat ride. On the way to the sites, we had a very pleasant and interesting chat with Emanuel and learned a lot a bout Ghanaian food and music. Thank you so much for this wonderful outing!

tripadvisor-25275033.title: Best Value! Best Experience!
tripadvisor-25275033.text:
I cannot say enough good things about the professionalism, knowledge and ease of booking with this company!!! Our driver Daniel was so laid back and with us every step of the way making sure we were comfortable and safe! He was truly a pleasure and even gave us some history about some of the areas that we passed by on the way to our excursion. If you want quality tours, affordable prices and reliable services please book right now!!!!
Tips for the excursions: pack your favorite light snacks or breakfast bars. We did stop for snacks on each excursion but I found it hard to find breakfast items that were quick and on the go, we traveled from the US. There are NO breakfast sandwiches that I’ve seen in Ghana (bacon, egg and cheese croissants, sausage biscuits, bagels and cream cheese), no prepackaged granola bars, so you’ll want to visit a ShopRite grocery store in the area to buy foods to have for early morning activities or bring them from wherever you’re traveling from.
Water and fun was provided!!! Get your camera and video settings prepared once you book because the memories will be priceless!!

tripadvisor-25225555.title: Great shopping and opportunity to learn more about the area
tripadvisor-25225555.text: In general a packed two days and lots of it spent in transit. We went to a lot of places and got a much better understanding in the current power of the Asante people. Highlights for me were the Kente cloth weaving workshop and the marketplace. I also really enjoyed the military museum ( I don’t think that’s what it’s officially called). I wasn’t well during the trip and the guides made sure I got medication and the rest I needed.
